fusions.name: Torpid Ring
fusions.desc: Weighs down every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 10 damage to each and stripping 10% armour and 30% movement speed for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Long-Awaited Blow
fusions.desc: A slow, heavy blow that deals 32 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Hold
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow-Grown Bulk
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12%, and you regenerate 0.4 health a second.
